Mood: tension, intrigue, foreboding. Inspired by the story "The Case of the Silent Violin". Let these themes set the atmosphere WITHOUT being drawn as objects or symbols: friendship, noticing details, honesty, music, set in A sunny primary school in Nairobi, Kenya, in the present day; a music room with drums and a piano, jacaranda trees in the yard, school uniforms, the day before the end-of-term concert. Include a distant silhouetted figure suggesting small Kenyan girl with dark brown skin, hair in neat cornrows with yellow beads, blue school uniform, oversized yellow rain boots, green notebook and pencil. Wardrobe: ordinary everyday clothing appropriate to the setting and era of the story, the same register of dress for every character regardless of ethnicity. Do not add ceremonial, festival, folk or traditional national dress unless the story explicitly calls for it. Compose it as a real book cover: ONE clear subject, one focal point, and a strong readable silhouette that still reads at thumbnail size. No collage, no split panels, no multiple vignettes, no floating symbolic objects. Keep the top 15% of the image free of faces and important detail, and place the main character's face between 20% and 50% of the image height; the bottom third may fade out. Depth over detail: simplify the background rather than filling it. Do not depict: anything scary, meanness without repair. The image must contain NO text, NO titles, NO words, NO letters, NO watermarks. Pure illustration only. Portrait orientation, subject centered in frame, high quality, professional book cover art.
